argv.reason: the probe requires a BREP directory as argv[1] and exits 2 with `usage: probe <brep-dir>` without one, so a run with no arguments measures nothing at all. The directory the capture used held the 990_*_shank.brep / 990_*_threaded.brep / 991_block.brep / 991_tapped.brep files that a temporary, since-reverted instrumentation of Issue990ThreadAxisBasisTests and Issue991ThreadProfileFlatWidthTests wrote; those files were never committed, so any directory gives the same result here and "." is the one that exists. Part 1, which is pure gp_Ax2 and needs no input, reproduces exactly.

rerun_drop.reason: with no committed BREP inputs each load fails and the probe prints `<axis>: BREP read failed` in place of the measurement. This is the documented rerun_drop case: a line the rerun prints that the capture's inputs made impossible.

transcript_only.reason: the six Issue990 groove measurements are of the solids the reverted Swift instrumentation wrote to BREP and nobody committed. They cannot be re-derived from this repository, so they are a record of that run rather than something this probe reproduces. Part 1's six YDirection lines, which are the part the Swift thread datum is checked against, do reproduce.
the one Issue991 cutPathStillCuts measurement, of the same uncommitted BREP pair. Same reason as the Issue990 lines above.
